$comment: Example session patch — the structured diff the tutor emits at wrap-up. See skills/references/document-formats.md for full semantics. Validate with: npm run commit-session -- --patch examples/session-patch.example.json --dry-run

lesson.whatHappened: 2–4 sentences: what was actually taught, how it went.
lesson.performanceSketch: Coarse, fair read of where the learner landed — what clicked, what didn't.
lesson.sourcesUsed: Named sources drawn on, or 'None named.'
lesson.feedbackCaptured: What the learner said in the wrap-up, or 'skipped'.
lesson.askedAbout: Which feedback topics were probed, so future sessions don't re-ask.

topicUpdates.notes: Replaces the topic's notes. Omit to keep. 'touched' defaults true (sets lastTouched).

topicUpdates.$comment: A graded recall warm-up: clean|rusty|miss. Drives the spacing streak; 'miss' also demotes to shaky unless 'state' is set explicitly.

nextUp.plan: One line: what's queued and how to open it. This is what makes next session's selection instant.

add: New hunch about how the learner learns (freely writable).
Newly settled feedback question — settled (Lesson N): don't re-ask.

proposedConfirmedPatterns: A candidate confirmed pattern. Printed for the learner, NEVER applied by the patcher.

approvedConfirmedPatterns.$comment: Only populate after the learner's explicit yes in-conversation.
